title: 7 Electric Pickups Americans Stopped Buying (What Really Happened)
description:
One electric truck lost seventy-nine percent of its sales in a single year, and it is the best-known electric pickup in America. Another one was cancelled before a single customer got it. A third one has a price tag of twenty-four thousand, nine hundred fifty dollars, and nobody has driven it yet. This is what really happened to the electric truck boom.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

18:16 What to check before you buy in 2027
